# RN Valves & Faucets

> India's fastest growing modern bathroom solutions company, specializing in Brass (CP) & PTMT (High Grade Engineering Polymer) bath fittings manufacturing with 7,000+ products and 5,000+ dealers across India since 2000.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: RN Valves & Faucets
- **Website**: https://rnvalves.com
- **Founded**: 2000
- **Founder & Managing Director**: Rajeev Jain
- **Headquarters**: B-68, Site-4, Sahibabad Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201010, India
- **Customer Care (Toll-Free)**: 1800 12340 0400
- **Complaint Helpline**: +91 9891201208

- **Email**: enquiry@rnvalves.com

## Product Categories
- [PTMT | High Grade Engineering Polymer Faucets](https://rnvalves.com/faucets/ptmt-taps-or-faucets): Rust-resistant, corrosion-resistant engineering polymer taps & collections (G20, Alpha Pro, Glamour, Lagoon, Virtu, Winsome, Felicity, M-Series).
- [CP Faucets](https://rnvalves.com/faucets/cp-faucets): Luxury Chrome Plated brass faucets, single lever mixers, diverters, and designer collections.
- [Showers](https://rnvalves.com/faucets/showers): Overhead showers, rain showers, hand showers, and shower arms.
- [Ball Valves & Plumbing Valves](https://rnvalves.com/faucets): Heavy-duty brass & PTMT valves for residential and commercial plumbing.
- [Bathroom Accessories & Allied Products](https://rnvalves.com/faucets): Soap dishes, towel rails, health faucets, jet sprays, waste pipes, garden pipes, and flushing cisterns.
